findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kyc_check · Private data: nl_home_report, nl_home_compare, nl_neighbourhood, nl_vehicle_report, nl_address_lookup, nl_address_reverse, nl_energy_label, nl_crime, eu_vat_check, eu_sanctions_screen, eu_sanctions_batch, company_lookup, nl_vehicle_compare, nl_apk_alert, nl_postcode_addresses, eu_sanctions_wallet, email_verify, phone_verify, kyc_check, nl_address_batch, nl_flood_risk, nl_house_prices · Public sink: nl_neighbourhood_summary, nl_car_model, nl_schools_near, nl_address_lookup, nl_address_reverse, email_verify, phone_verify, kyc_check · Destructive: eu_vat_check, nl_apk_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kyc_check · Private data: nl_home_report, nl_home_compare, nl_neighbourhood, nl_vehicle_report, nl_address_lookup, nl_address_reverse, nl_energy_label, nl_crime, eu_vat_check, eu_sanctions_screen, eu_sanctions_batch, company_lookup, nl_vehicle_compare, nl_apk_alert, nl_postcode_addresses, eu_sanctions_wallet, email_verify, phone_verify, kyc_check, nl_address_batch, nl_flood_risk, nl_house_prices · Public sink: nl_neighbourhood_summary, nl_car_model, nl_schools_near, nl_address_lookup, nl_address_reverse, email_verify, phone_verify, kyc_check · Destructive: eu_vat_check, nl_apk_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
